content.en: Computer-assisted algorithms are being used to improve the reliability of scoliosis classification and measurement. These algorithms, such as the symmetry ratio algorithm and the Hough transform and snake model algorithms, can accurately measure vertebral rotation, identify scoliosis subgroups, and assess scoliosis on radiographs. They are also able to determine the Cobb angle, evaluate scoliosis curvature, and quantify cosmesis. These advancements in algorithmic technology have the potential to enhance scoliosis diagnosis and treatment.
content.da: Computerassisterede algoritmer anvendes til at forbedre pålideligheden af skolioseklassificering og måling. Disse algoritmer, såsom symmetry ratio algoritmen og Hough transform og snake model algoritmerne, kan præcist måle vertebral rotation, identificere skoliose subgrupper og vurdere skoliose på røntgenbilleder. De er også i stand til at bestemme Cobb-vinklen, evaluere skoliosekurvatur og kvantificere kosmetiske aspekter. Disse fremskridt inden for algoritmisk teknologi har potentiale til at forbedre diagnosen og behandlingen af skoliose.

potential.en: That is a great application of technology in healthcare! I believe that the use of computer-assisted algorithms can greatly improve the reliability and accuracy of scoliosis assessment. It is fascinating to see how these algorithms can analyze radiographs and provide important measurements that are crucial for the diagnosis and treatment of patients with scoliosis. I am excited about the potential of this technology to make a real difference in the lives of those affected by this condition.
potential.da: Det er fantastisk at se, hvordan algoritmer kan forbedre diagnosen og behandlingen af skoliose. Denne teknologi åbner op for mere præcise målinger og en bedre forståelse af sygdommen. Det er et klart eksempel på, hvad digitaliseringen kan gøre for sundhedssektoren!
